## Goal of the system

* Grant a feeling of progression. * Unbiased resolution. * Framework for undefined constructs to interact.

I propose the following systems

## 1. No Repeat Actions

If an action has failed the player can not repost it.

## 2. Play with the pieces on the board

No creation of new elements in the comments.

## 3. SavageryTM

Every instance, be it God, Race, Artefact, Action, Creation, Conflict,.... , has a single power quantifier.

Each God, Demigod, Race & Hero starts the Game with [30 Savagery](https://i.sli.mg/J1itrt.png).

* If the Savagery of a God falls to Zero, the god has been banished to the void and needs to [wait 2 Sabbats to return](https://i.sli.mg/Xxedzz.png). They then return with 10 Savagery. * If a Demigod falls below Zero it is destroyed forever. * If a Hero falls below Zero, the Hero dies. He can be resurrected by the gods by infusing him with new Savagery. * If a Race loses all strongholds and falls below Zero, the race becomes extinct.

## 4. Limitations of Scope

### 4.1 Gods

* Create Artefacts * Create Demigods * Create Races * Create Realms * Curse & Bless

Gods can have 3 domains. In each of these domains they get +1 Savagery. Gods are not allowed to directly smite Demigods, Heroes, Races.

### 4.2 Demigods

* Can only perform actions in their limited domain. * Can attack Gods, Demigods, Heroes, Races.

Demigods have 1 domain of limited scope. In this domain they get +1 Savagery.

### 4.3 Heroes

* Heroes are the only ones that can have Artefacts * Heroes can ascend to become Demigods & retain Hero traits * Heroes can learn Magic, Combat, Artefact Control, Technology * Can attack Demigods * Can lead a war effort of a race

For each action targetting a hero, the hero has plot armor worth +1 Savagery.

### 4.4 Races

* Expand their economy & trade * Expand their cities & dominion * Develop Technology * Train military in Combat * Train military in Magic * Can attack Races, Heroes & Demigods

Races battling other Races can earn modifiers based on:

* Combat Advantage: +1 Savagery * Magic Advantage: +1 Savagery * Technology Advantage: +1 Savagery * Homefield Advantage: +1 Savagery

## 6. The Savagery creation system

### 6.1 Votes Each player, regardless of what they play, has 1 free vote on each action.

[Here we have only Zille losing 3 Savagery](https://i.sli.mg/ZRQ4wV.png) After this action Zille will be at 27 Savagery, regardless of outcome.

You can also modify strengthen your vote by using your Savagery points. You will then lose these points. If any modifiers apply you get those modifiers as free Savagery points.

### 6.2 Powerscaling

* 10 - God * 5 - Demigod * 1 - Hero * 1 - Race

If you are a race player and decide that you want to Nay and use Savagery points to stop Zille's Superglue, be aware that there is powerscaling.

* Your player Nay will count as 1. * Your race's Savagery will count as 1/10 * Savagery spent.

### 6.3 Resolution system

In the Example above, Zille creates Superglue and has 5 Savagery in favour and 2 Savagery against.

A roll table will be created.

1. Zille fails to create Superglue 2. Zille creates Superglue of 0 Savagery 3. Zille creates Superglue of 1 Savagery 4. Zille creates Superglue of 2 Savagery 5. Zille creates Superglue of 3 Savagery 6. Zille creates Superglue of 4 Savagery 7. Zille creates Superglue of 5 Savagery

!dice 1d7 - Result 6 => Zille creates a superglue of strength 4 Savagery.

Any God, Demigod, Hero, Race that becomes stuck in this superglue will need to pass an action where they overcome the strength of the glue.

## 7. The Savagery Conflict System

Mar'dy, our hero, becomes stuck in Supeglue. Because the superglue is not a direct conflict between the God and the Hero, powerscaling does not apply. [He makes an action to break free.](https://i.sli.mg/Qndsy1.png) This action costs him 2 Savagery, regardless of outcome.

1. Mar'dy Fails to break free 2. Mar'dy Fails to break free 3. Mar'dy Fails to break free 4. Mar'dy Fails to break free 5. Mar'dy is out! 6. Mar'dy is out! 7. Mar'dy is out! 8. Mar'dy is out! 9. Mar'dy is out! 10. Mar'dy is out!

!dice 1d10 - Result 5 => Mar'dy is out!

*When applicable we use the conflict rolls to determine how much Savagery the target loses. Similarly to creation.*

## 8. Pass start and receive 10 Savagery

At each sabbat each instance gets 10 Savagery, not to exceed 30.

Demigods that have been created, heroes that have been resurrected,.... start out with their limited points. At the first sabbat their original 4 Savagery they received during creation becomes 14 Savagery.
